title: Fox Is a Traitor to Democracy; False That He Saved AMLO From Impeachment, Sheinbaum Says
author: Nancy Flores
content:
_This article by[Nancy
Flores](https://contralinea.com.mx/author/nancy_contra/) originally appeared
in the [August 26, 2026 edition of
Contralínea](https://contralinea.com.mx/interno/semana/fox-es-un-traidor-a-la-
democracia-falso-que-salvo-a-amlo-del-desafuero-sheinbaum/), a Mexican
investigative magazine._

Now that right-winger Vicente Fox Quesada has come out in defense of Ernesto
Ruffo Appel and in an open campaign against Morena —ahead of the upcoming 2027
elections—, and even claimed that he saved Andrés Manuel from the removal of
his immunity in 2005, President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo stated that the PAN
member is a traitor to democracy.

In this regard, she recalled that Fox Quesada not only directly promoted the
removal of immunity, but that in 2006 he operated the electoral fraud against
López Obrador, to impose Felipe Calderón in the Presidency.

Sheinbaum considered it incredible that Fox now speaks of a lack of democracy
and charges that "we are at the worst moment," because it was he who, during
his term, operated against the people's decision at the ballot box. Regarding
the right-wing politician's remarks about AMLO's removal of immunity, the
president explained that he invented the crimes for which they sought to try
López Obrador.

> "The PRI had been, had placed the presidents practically throughout the 20th
> century, obviously after the Revolution; and for the first time there is
> going to be a change of government [in the year 2000], a new political
> party: the PAN is going to reach the Presidency. And the people, excited
> that a change is coming, vote for Fox. And one of Fox's central elements was
> democracy, right?, the transition to democracy, because it went from Vargas
> Llosa's "perfect dictatorship" to the "transition to democracy." [But] four
> years later, Fox invents a crime for López Obrador so that he could not
> participate in the 2006 election."

She recalled that the false crime was that, as head of government of Mexico
City, López Obrador violated an injunction. "What injunction? Or why did he
violate an injunction? Because there was an injunction from a private party
over the construction of a street to a hospital. In the first place, it was
shown that he never violated the injunction. But, in the second [place], well,
it was a street to a hospital. That is, it was not like, 'hey, what a terrible
crime.' But anyway, they invented the crime. They took it to the Public
Prosecutor, and a judge said he 'was guilty,' despite the demonstration that
he was not. And then comes the removal of López Obrador's immunity so that
they could put him in jail."

The president recalled that it was not Fox who saved Andrés Manuel, but rather
the mobilized people who forced the government to back down. "And what
happens? Well, at that moment in Mexico City he had a lot of popularity,
because he had introduced the Wellbeing Programs, so the social programs, the
Elderly Pension was created in the City. So, he was head of government. They
criticized him terribly for having established the Elderly Pension and others…
also the Support for People with Disabilities, his two main programs. And the
people loved him a lot, love him a lot, but in the City very much so. When the
removal of immunity comes, well, the people take to the streets, gigantic
demonstrations […]."

At her morning press conference —and asked by Contralínea about the PRIAN
politicians who did so much damage to the country in the neoliberal era and
who now, openly and covertly, take part in the dirty media war—, she added
that the protests spread across the whole country, "because throughout the
country word had already spread: 'oh, there's a person, López Obrador, who is
governing Mexico City very well!, he has an Elderly Pension, People with
Disabilities, he's building a second deck, he's fixing the Historic Center.'
And the people came out massively to support him."

For that reason, she stressed, "Fox had no choice but to reverse the crime,
the best demonstration that it was a falsehood. Ah, López Obrador decides to
run for the Presidency of the Republic in 2006. And Fox is the architect of
the 2006 electoral fraud, so that López Obrador would not make it. […] Imagine
how the country would be today, imagine, since then, if López Obrador had
fortunately governed from 2006 to 2012. But, well, the people of Mexico
decided, in 2018, to say 'now yes, let the real change come,' and López
Obrador arrived in 2018."

Sheinbaum Pardo remarked ironically that now Fox is very active, supposedly
for democracy.

> Since then we gave it a name: "Fox, traitor to democracy." He betrayed
> democracy, and now he's the one who talks about democracy.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum
